pages.text: Craft shisha from exactly $(item)1 loose tobacco$() plus $(item)1 to 3 flavored molasses bottles$(). The ingredients may be placed anywhere in the crafting grid; no unrelated items may be present.
Each flavor bottle is reusable for $(item)4 shisha crafts$(). Every craft damages each flavor bottle used by one step. When its fourth use is consumed, that bottle disappears.
pages.title: Reusable Flavor Bottles

pages.text: For shisha, $(thing)Rough Cut$() is ideal. Ribbon is the second-best choice. Flake is workable but capped lower, and Shag is strongly penalized. The finished shisha keeps the tobacco's aging, fermentation, and ruined state.
pages.title: Best Cut

pages.text: Using 2 or 3 flavor bottles records a multi-flavor blend on the shisha. The hookah does not require a particular flavor; any shisha item produced by this recipe can be loaded into its shisha slot.
pages.title: Blends
